actions.popupBlocked: The print window was blocked — allow pop-ups for this site and try again.

list.title: Invoices
list.subtitle: Sales invoices, payments and credit notes
list.sumsHint: Sums cover every invoice matching the filters (all pages): net {{net}}, VAT {{vat}}. Outstanding and overdue count only sent, unpaid invoices.
list.emptyHint: Create the first invoice to start billing customers.
list.emptyFilteredHint: Try a wider date range or clear the filters.
list.noOverdueHint: Every sent invoice is either paid or still within its payment terms.

editor.subtitle: Drafts can be edited freely until they are sent.
editor.detailsHint: The customer is required. The due date follows the issue date and payment terms, but you can change it.
editor.customerSearch: Search by name, email or Business ID…
editor.noCustomers: No matching customers — add them on the Customers page first.
editor.languageHint: Set from the customer's language; decides the PDF and email language.
editor.modelHint: Where the income is booked when the invoice is sent.
editor.dueHint: Calculated from issue date + terms; editable.
editor.periodHint: Shown on the invoice, e.g. a rental period.
editor.fromRental: This invoice is created from rental #{{id}} ({{period}}). Sending it moves the rental's income entry to Invoiced — no income is counted twice.
editor.rentalVoid: This rental is voided — it cannot be invoiced.
editor.rentalPaid: This rental is already marked paid — sending an invoice for it will be refused.
editor.rentalNoCustomer: The rental has no customer card (recorded as "{{name}}") — choose or create the customer.

lines.title: Invoice lines
lines.hint: Prices include VAT. Product names follow the invoice language ({{language}}).
lines.productSearchPlaceholder: Search products by name or SKU, or type a barcode and press Enter…
lines.scanHint: Scanning a barcode anywhere on this page adds the product (scanning it again increases the quantity).
lines.empty: No lines yet — search for a product, scan a barcode or add a free-text line.

detail.title: Invoice {{number}}
detail.lockedHint: Sent invoices cannot be edited. To correct one, issue a credit note and create a new invoice.
detail.cancelledHint: This invoice was fully credited and is cancelled. Its income entry has been voided.
detail.readOnlyHint: Your role can view invoices but not change them.
detail.noPaymentsDraft: Send the invoice first — payments are recorded against sent invoices.
detail.noPaymentsHint: Use "Record payment" when the money arrives.
detail.creditNotesHint: Credits reduce what the customer owes; a full credit cancels the invoice.
detail.notFoundHint: It may have been removed, or the link is wrong.

send.title: Send invoice {{number}}?
send.explain: Sending locks the invoice and books {{amount}} as invoiced income: an income entry is created (status Invoiced, VAT invoice) and follows the payments you record. This cannot be undone — later corrections need a credit note.
send.emailHint: The PDF is attached to the email and also stored with the invoice.
send.noEmailHint: Leave empty to mark the invoice as sent without emailing it (e.g. handed over on paper).

remind.title: Send a payment reminder for {{number}}?
remind.explain: A reminder email for the open amount of {{amount}} is sent to the customer.
remind.emailHint: Leave empty to use the customer's email address.

payment.title: Record payment — {{number}}
payment.referenceHint: Optional, e.g. the bank archive ID.
payment.overpay: This is more than the remaining amount.
payment.lookupsFailed: Payment methods and receivers could not be loaded.
payment.doneFull: Payment recorded — the invoice is fully paid

credit.title: Credit note for {{number}}
credit.fullBlocked: Earlier credit notes exist, so only the remaining lines can be credited.
credit.fullExplain: The whole invoice ({{amount}}) is credited: the invoice becomes Cancelled and its income entry is voided.
credit.partialExplain: Choose the lines and quantities to credit. A reversing income entry is booked for the credited amount.
credit.restockHint: Tick when the returned parts are back on the shelf and can be sold again.
credit.pickLines: Select at least one line to credit.
credit.confirmFull: Invoice {{number}} is credited in full ({{amount}}) and cancelled. Credit notes cannot be undone.
credit.confirmPartial: A credit note of about {{amount}} is issued against invoice {{number}}. Credit notes cannot be undone.
credit.doneCancelled: Credit note {{number}} issued — the invoice is cancelled

validation.dueBeforeIssue: The due date cannot be before the issue date
validation.amount: Enter an amount greater than zero
validation.lineQty: Quantity must be more than 0 (max 2 decimals)
validation.lineDiscount: Discount must be between 0 and the line amount
